title: Economy: Five Year Plan (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en: What was the actual growth rate of the first five-year plan?
questions.solution_en: During India's First Five-Year Plan (1951-56), the actual growth rate achieved was 3.6%. This performance exceeded the initial target growth rate of 2.1%. The plan primarily concentrated on developing the primary sector, with special emphasis on agriculture, irrigation, power projects, and transportation infrastructure development.
questions.solution_hi: भारत की प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-56) के दौरान वास्तविक विकास दर 3.6% रही, जो 2.1% के प्रारंभिक लक्ष्य से अधिक थी। इस योजना में मुख्यतः प्राथमिक क्षेत्र, विशेषकर कृषि, सिंचाई, बिजली परियोजनाओं व परिवहन अवसंरचना विकास पर बल दिया गया।

questions.q_en: Which Five Year Plan period saw the initiation of the Hill Area Development Programme?
questions.solution_en:
The Hill Area Development Programme (HADP) was initiated during the Fifth Five Year Plan (1974-1979). The program aimed at the socio-economic development of designated hill areas, focusing on ecological balance and sustainable development.

Explanation of Other Options:

• Sixth Five Year Plan (1980-1985)

• Fourth Five Year Plan (1969-1974): Some pilot projects for hill areas might have started, but the formal HADP is associated with the Fifth Plan.

• Eighth Five Year Plan (1992-1997)

Further insights:

• The HADP covered specific hill areas in states like Assam, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh (now Uttarakhand), and the Western Ghats region.

• The program focused on sectors like agriculture, horticulture, forestry, soil conservation, animal husbandry, and development of infrastructure.

• It recognized the unique geographical and ecological challenges faced by hill regions.
questions.solution_hi:
पर्वतीय क्षेत्र विकास कार्यक्रम (HADP) पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974-1979) में शुरू हुआ। इसका उद्देश्य निर्धारित पर्वतीय क्षेत्रों का सामाजिक-आर्थिक विकास, पारिस्थितिक संतुलन व सतत विकास था।

अन्य विकल्पों की व्याख्या:

• छठी पंचवर्षीय योजना (1980-1985)

• चौथी पंचवर्षीय योजना (1969-1974): कुछ पायलट परियोजनाएँ शुरू हुई होंगी, परंतु औपचारिक HADP पाँचवीं योजना से जुड़ा है।

• आठवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1992-1997)

questions.q_en:
The five-year plans for India with their duration are given below. Which of the following is correctly matched?

(a) Second five-year plan1956-57 to 1960-61
(b) Third five-year plan1961-62 to 1965-66
(c) Fourth five-year plan1966-67 to 1970-71
questions.solution_en:
The five-year plans in India were a series of centralized economic development programs implemented by the Government of India. Below is the correct duration of each plan:

1) Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)

o The second five-year plan was from 1956 to 1961, focusing on rapid industrialization, especially in heavy industries like steel, machinery, and mining.

o The given duration in the question (1956-57 to 1960-61) is incorrect because the plan started in 1956 and ended in 1961.

2) Third Five-Year Plan (1961-1966)

o The third five-year plan was from 1961 to 1966, aiming at self-reliance and agricultural production improvement.

o The given duration in the question (1961-62 to 1965-66) is incorrect because the plan started in 1961, not 1961-62.

3) Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974)

o The fourth five-year plan was from 1969 to 1974, focusing on growth with stability and progress towards self-reliance.

o The given duration in the question (1966-67 to 1970-71) is incorrect because there was a three-year gap (1966-69) between the third and fourth plans due to economic instability, during which annual plans were implemented.

Final Conclusion:

The answer key (D: Both a and b) is incorrect based on the actual historical data.

Since none of the options are correct, this question appears to have a mistake. The correct durations should be:

· Second Plan: 1956-1961

· Third Plan: 1961-1966

· Fourth Plan: 1969-1974
questions.solution_hi:
भारत की पंचवर्षीय योजनाएँ भारत सरकार द्वारा लागू केंद्रीकृत आर्थिक विकास कार्यक्रमों की श्रृंखला थीं। नीचे प्रत्येक योजना की सही अवधि दी गई है:

1) द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956-1961) - भारी उद्योगों (स्टील, मशीनरी, खनन) पर केंद्रित तीव्र औद्योगीकरण।

2) तृतीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1961-1966)।

इस प्रकार सही मिलान वाला विकल्प ही सही उत्तर है।

questions.q_en: The Mahalanobis model was the basis for which Five-Year Plan?
questions.solution_en:
The Mahalanobis model, developed by statistician Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis, was crucial in India's economic planning.

Key points:

Formed the theoretical basis of the Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)

Emphasized rapid industrialization and socialist pattern of development

Focused on heavy industries and public sector growth

Proposed a balanced approach to economic development

Influenced by the Soviet model of economic planning

Aimed to transform India from an agrarian to an industrial economy

Mahalanobis was a key economic advisor to Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru
questions.solution_hi:
सांख्यिकीविद् प्रशांत चंद्र महालनोबिस द्वारा विकसित महालनोबिस मॉडल भारत की आर्थिक योजना में महत्वपूर्ण रहा।

मुख्य बिंदु:

द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956-1961) का सैद्धांतिक आधार बना

तीव्र औद्योगीकरण व विकास के समाजवादी स्वरूप पर बल दिया

भारी उद्योगों व सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की वृद्धि पर केंद्रित

आर्थिक विकास हेतु संतुलित दृष्टिकोण प्रस्तावित किया

सोवियत आर्थिक योजना मॉडल से प्रभावित

भारत को कृषि प्रधान से औद्योगिक अर्थव्यवस्था में बदलने का लक्ष्य रखा

महालनोबिस प्रधानमंत्री के प्रमुख आर्थिक सलाहकार थे।

questions.q_en: Which of the following options is INCORRECT?
options_en: Distinguished economists from India and abroad were invited to advise on India's economic development during the first five-year plan period.
India borrowed the idea of five-year plans from the former Soviet Union.
The Planning Commission of India was set up in 1950.
The chairmanship of the Planning Commission of India was given to the Prime Minister.
questions.solution_en:
• The First Five-Year Plan (1951 - 56) was based on the Harrod-Domar model and largely guided by Indian economists, including K.N. Raj.

• Though influenced by the Soviet model, it did not involve foreign economists directly advising.

• The Planning Commission was indeed established in 1950 with the Prime Minister as its chairperson.
questions.solution_hi:
• प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-56) हैरॉड-डोमर मॉडल पर आधारित थी और मुख्यतः भारतीय अर्थशास्त्रियों, जिनमें के.एन. राज शामिल थे, द्वारा निर्देशित थी।

• यद्यपि यह सोवियत मॉडल से प्रभावित थी, इसमें विदेशी अर्थशास्त्रियों की प्रत्यक्ष सलाह शामिल नहीं थी।

• योजना आयोग वास्तव में 1950 में स्थापित हुआ था, जिसके अध्यक्ष प्रधानमंत्री होते थे।

questions.q_en: What is NOT a goal of Five-Year Plans?
options_en: Equal benefits to all the people
questions.solution_en: The objectives of the five-year plans were to achieve growth, modernization, equity, and self-reliance. High Population Growth is not a goal of Five Year plan.
questions.solution_hi: पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं के उद्देश्य विकास, आधुनिकीकरण, समानता व आत्मनिर्भरता प्राप्त करना था। उच्च जनसंख्या वृद्धि पंचवर्षीय योजना का लक्ष्य नहीं है।

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statements are true?

i. The First Five-Year Plan was based on the PC Mahalnobis model.

ii. The First Five-Year Plan laid emphasis on agriculture development.

iii. The First Five-Year Plan model in india was borrowed from Russia.
questions.solution_en:
· Statement i is incorrect: The First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956) was not based on the P.C. Mahalanobis model. Instead, it was inspired by the Harrod-Domar model, which focused on capital formation and investment. The Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961) was based on the Mahalanobis model, which emphasized heavy industries and economic self-reliance.

· Statement ii is correct: The First Five-Year Plan focused on agricultural development to achieve food self-sufficiency. The major projects under this plan included the Bhakra-Nangal Dam and Hirakud Dam.

· Statement iii is correct: The planning model for the First Five-Year Plan in India was inspired by Russia (Soviet Union), which had a centralized economic planning system. However, the Indian model was adapted to suit its own economic conditions.

Thus, the correct answer is A. Only ii and iii.
questions.solution_hi:
• कथन i गलत है: प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-1956) पी.सी. महालनोबिस मॉडल पर आधारित नहीं थी, बल्कि हैरॉड-डोमर मॉडल से प्रेरित थी, जो पूँजी निर्माण व निवेश पर केंद्रित था। द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956-1961) महालनोबिस मॉडल पर आधारित थी, जिसमें भारी उद्योग व आर्थिक आत्मनिर्भरता पर बल था।

• कथन ii सही है: प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना खाद्य आत्मनिर्भरता हेतु कृषि विकास पर केंद्रित थी। इसके प्रमुख प्रोजेक्ट्स में भाखड़ा-नांगल बांध व हीराकुंड बांध शामिल थे।

• कथन iii गलत है।

questions.q_en: Harrod Domar model was the main idea behind the __________ Five Year Plan.
questions.solution_en:
· The Harrod-Domar model emphasizes capital accumulation and investment for economic growth.

· India's First Five-Year Plan (1951-56) focused on agriculture, irrigation, and power following this model.
questions.solution_hi:
• हैरॉड-डोमर मॉडल आर्थिक विकास हेतु पूँजी संचय व निवेश पर बल देता है।

• भारत की प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-56) इसी मॉडल का अनुसरण करते हुए कृषि, सिंचाई व बिजली पर केंद्रित थी।

questions.q_en:
P.C. Mahalanobis is remembered as a major contributor to India's developmental path because he:

(A) Set up the Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs)

(B) Formulated the Second Five-Year Plan

(C) Was the first Minister of Statistics and Programme Implementation
questions.solution_en:
· Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis, an Indian statistician, is best known for formulating the Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961).

· This plan was based on the Mahalanobis Model, which emphasized heavy industries and rapid economic growth.

· He was the founder of the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) and played a crucial role in developing statistical methods for economic planning.

· His work in statistics also led to the Mahalanobis Distance, a measure used in data science and classification problems.

· He is often called the "Father of Indian Statistics."

Misconception: While he contributed to India's educational development, he did not set up IIMs, nor was he a Minister of Statistics.
questions.solution_hi:
• प्रशांत चंद्र महालनोबिस, एक भारतीय सांख्यिकीविद्, द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956-1961) तैयार करने हेतु सर्वाधिक जाने जाते हैं।

• यह योजना महालनोबिस मॉडल पर आधारित थी, जिसमें भारी उद्योग व तीव्र आर्थिक विकास पर बल था।

• वे भारतीय सांख्यिकी संस्थान (ISI) के संस्थापक थे और आर्थिक योजना हेतु सांख्यिकीय पद्धतियाँ विकसित करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

• उनके सांख्यिकी कार्य से महालनोबिस दूरी (Mahalanobis Distance) की अवधारणा बनी, जो डेटा साइंस व वर्गीकरण समस्याओं में प्रयुक्त होती है।

• उन्हें प्रायः "भारतीय सांख्यिकी के जनक" कहा जाता है।

questions.q_en: _____ was the chairman of the planning commission when the first five-year plan was formulated in India.
questions.solution_en: Jawaharlal Nehru was the one who headed the Planning Commission when it was set up by the Indian Government through an Executive Resolution on 15 March 1950. He also led the first Five-Year Plan in 1951, which aimed to boost the agricultural sector. The Planning Commission was abolished in 2014 and replaced by NITI Aayog.
questions.solution_hi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू योजना आयोग के अध्यक्ष थे जब इसकी स्थापना 15 मार्च 1950 को भारत सरकार द्वारा एक कार्यकारी संकल्प (Executive Resolution) के माध्यम से हुई। उन्होंने 1951 में पहली पंचवर्षीय योजना का भी नेतृत्व किया, जिसका उद्देश्य कृषि क्षेत्र को बढ़ावा देना था। योजना आयोग को 2014 में समाप्त कर नीति आयोग से प्रतिस्थापित किया गया।

questions.q_en: Which of the following statements is correct?.
options_en: The five-year plan focuses mostly on private intervention in the economy.
The five-year plan always focused on the growth of the tertiary sector.
The five-year plan permits long-term intervention by the government in the economy.
A five-year plan always stresses market-oriented activities.
questions.solution_en:
Statement 1: Incorrect. Five-year plans in India focused on government intervention to promote balanced economic development, especially in key sectors like agriculture, industry, and infrastructure.

Statement 2: Correct. The five-year plans were designed to allow long-term government intervention to achieve planned economic goals, including reducing poverty, boosting industrial and agricultural production, and addressing social inequities.

Statement 3: Incorrect. While some plans emphasized the tertiary sector (services), they also focused on primary (agriculture) and secondary (industry) sectors, depending on the priorities of the plan.

Statement 4: Incorrect. The five-year plans were not solely market-oriented; they followed a mixed economy model, combining market mechanisms with government planning and regulation.
questions.solution_hi:
कथन 1: गलत। भारत में पंचवर्षीय योजनाएँ मुख्य क्षेत्रों जैसे कृषि, उद्योग व अवसंरचना में संतुलित आर्थिक विकास हेतु सरकारी हस्तक्षेप पर केंद्रित थीं।

कथन 2: सही। पंचवर्षीय योजनाएँ दीर्घकालिक सरकारी हस्तक्षेप द्वारा निर्धारित आर्थिक लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने हेतु बनाई गई थीं, जिसमें गरीबी घटाना, औद्योगिक व कृषि उत्पादन बढ़ाना, और सामाजिक असमानताओं को दूर करना शामिल था।

कथन 3: गलत। कुछ योजनाओं में तृतीयक क्षेत्र (सेवाओं) पर बल दिया गया, परंतु उन्होंने प्राथमिक (कृषि) व द्वितीयक क्षेत्र पर भी ध्यान दिया।

questions.q_en: In which five-year plan was the 'food, work, and productivity' slogan used?
questions.solution_en:
The 'food, work, and productivity' slogan was used in the Seventh Five-Year Plan of India.

Five-Year Plans in India are detailed macroeconomic plans created by the Planning Commission (now NITI Aayog) to guide economic development. The Seventh Five-Year Plan, which ran from 1985 to 1990, emphasized economic growth, agricultural productivity, and employment generation.

The slogan "food, work, and productivity" reflected the plan's focus on addressing basic economic needs, creating employment opportunities, and improving overall economic efficiency.
questions.solution_hi:
'खाद्य, काम और उत्पादकता' नारा भारत की सातवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना में प्रयुक्त हुआ।

भारत की पंचवर्षीय योजनाएँ योजना आयोग (अब नीति आयोग) द्वारा आर्थिक विकास हेतु बनाई गई विस्तृत स्थूल आर्थिक योजनाएँ हैं। सातवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना, जो 1985 से 1990 तक चली, आर्थिक विकास, कृषि उत्पादकता व रोज़गार सृजन पर केंद्रित थी।

"खाद्य, काम और उत्पादकता" नारा बुनियादी आर्थिक आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने, रोज़गार अवसर सृजित करने व समग्र आर्थिक दक्षता सुधारने पर योजना के फोकस को दर्शाता है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following years were considered plan holidays in Independent India?
questions.solution_en:
• The period 1966 - 1969 was considered Plan Holidays in India.

• This break between the 3rd and 4th Five-Year Plans was due to economic instability, wars, and droughts.

• Instead of a full plan, annual plans were implemented during this time.
questions.solution_hi:
• 1966-1969 की अवधि को भारत में प्लान हॉलिडे (Plan Holidays) माना जाता है।

• तीसरी व चौथी पंचवर्षीय योजना के बीच यह ब्रेक आर्थिक अस्थिरता, युद्ध व सूखे के कारण आया।

• पूर्ण योजना के स्थान पर इस अवधि में वार्षिक योजनाएँ लागू की गईं।

questions.q_en: What was the duration of rolling plan in India?
questions.solution_en: The Fifth Five Year Plan began in 1974-75 but it was terminated by the then government one year earlier i.e. in 1977-78. Then a rolling plan was formulated in 1978-1980.
questions.solution_hi: पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना 1974-75 में शुरू हुई थी परंतु तत्कालीन सरकार ने इसे एक वर्ष पहले, यानी 1977-78 में समाप्त कर दिया। इसके बाद 1978-1980 में एक रोलिंग योजना बनाई गई।

questions.q_en: The Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61) had a major goal of achieving which of the following targets?
options_en: Rapid industrialisation with focus on heavy industries
questions.solution_en: The primary goal of the Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61) was rapid industrialization with a focus on heavy industries. This plan aimed to boost India's industrial capacity and reduce dependency on imports for heavy machinery and infrastructure development.
questions.solution_hi: द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956-61) का प्रमुख लक्ष्य भारी उद्योगों पर केंद्रित तीव्र औद्योगीकरण प्राप्त करना था। इस योजना का उद्देश्य भारत की औद्योगिक क्षमता बढ़ाना और भारी मशीनरी व अवसंरचना विकास हेतु आयात पर निर्भरता घटाना था।

questions.q_en: The 10th Five-Year Plan aimed at reducing poverty by:
questions.solution_en:
· The 10th Five-Year Plan (2002 - 2007) aimed to reduce poverty by 5 percentage points (from 26% to 21%) over its duration.

· Key strategies included:

o Faster economic growth (target: 8% GDP growth).

o Employment generation (focus on agriculture, small industries).

o Social sector spending (education, health, rural infrastructure).
questions.solution_hi:
• 10वीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (2002-2007) का लक्ष्य अपनी अवधि में गरीबी को 5 प्रतिशत अंक घटाना (26% से 21%) था।

• प्रमुख रणनीतियों में शामिल थीं:

o तीव्र आर्थिक विकास (लक्ष्य: 8% GDP वृद्धि)

o रोज़गार सृजन (कृषि, लघु उद्योगों पर बल)

o सामाजिक क्षेत्र व्यय (शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, ग्रामीण अवसंरचना)

questions.q_en: Which Five-Year Plan primarily focused on the 'Garibi Hatao' initiative?
questions.solution_en:
The Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974 - 1978) primarily focused on the 'Garibi Hatao' (Eradicate Poverty) initiative.

The slogan "Garibi Hatao" was a cornerstone of Indira Gandhi's political campaign during the early 1970s. This focus on poverty eradication became central to the Fifth Five-Year Plan, which aimed to address widespread poverty and inequality in India.
questions.solution_hi:
पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974-1978) मुख्यतः 'गरीबी हटाओ' (Eradicate Poverty) पहल पर केंद्रित थी।

"गरीबी हटाओ" नारा 1970 के दशक की शुरुआत में इंदिरा गांधी के राजनीतिक अभियान का मुख्य आधार था। गरीबी उन्मूलन पर यह फोकस पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना का केंद्र बिंदु बना, जिसका उद्देश्य भारत में व्यापक गरीबी व असमानता को दूर करना था।

questions.q_en:
Match the items in List I with those in List II:

List IList II
i. Garibi Hataoa. Fifth Five-Year Plan
ii. LPG policiesb. Ninth Five-Year Plan
iii. Rolling Planc. 1978-80
iv. Growth with justice and equityd. Eighth Five-Year Plan
questions.solution_en:
· The "Garibi Hatao" (Remove Poverty) slogan was launched by Indira Gandhi during the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974 - 1979).

· LPG stands for Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization, introduced in 1991 during the Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992 - 1997).

· The Rolling Plan was introduced by the Janata Government and covered the period 1978 - 1980, replacing the traditional 5-year plans temporarily.

· The Ninth Five-Year Plan (1997 - 2002) emphasized growth with social justice and equity.
questions.solution_hi:
• "गरीबी हटाओ" नारा इंदिरा गांधी द्वारा पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974-1979) के दौरान शुरू किया गया।

• LPG का अर्थ है उदारीकरण, निजीकरण व वैश्वीकरण, जो 1991 में आठवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1992-1997) के दौरान लागू हुआ।

• रोलिंग प्लान जनता सरकार द्वारा शुरू किया गया और यह 1978-1980 की अवधि को कवर करता था, जो अस्थायी रूप से परंपरागत 5-वर्षीय योजनाओं का स्थान लिया।

• नौवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1997-2002) में सामाजिक न्याय के साथ विकास पर बल दिया गया।

questions.q_en:
Plan revenue expenditure relates to

I.Five-years plans

II.Salaries and pensions
questions.solution_en:
This is essentially the budget support to the Central Plan and the Central assistance to State and Union Territory plans. Like all budget heads, this is also split into revenue and capital components.

Any expenditure that is incurred on programmes which are detailed under the current (Five Year) Plan of the centre or centre's advances to state for their plans Is called plan expenditure. Provision of such expenditure in the budget is called Plan Expenditure
questions.solution_hi:
यह मूलतः केंद्रीय योजना को बजट सहायता और राज्य व केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों की योजनाओं हेतु केंद्रीय सहायता है। सभी बजट मदों की तरह, इसे भी राजस्व व पूँजीगत घटकों में विभाजित किया जाता है।

केंद्र की चालू (पंचवर्षीय) योजना के अंतर्गत विस्तृत कार्यक्रमों पर होने वाला व्यय या राज्यों को उनकी योजनाओं हेतु केंद्र के अग्रिम को योजना व्यय कहा जाता है। बजट में ऐसे व्यय के प्रावधान को योजना व्यय कहते हैं।

questions.q_en: Which of the Five-Year Plans was prepared and launched by DP Dhar?
questions.solution_en: D.P. Dhar played a key role in the initiation of the Minimum Needs Programme (MNP) during the initial year of the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974 - 78). This program aimed to address fundamental requirements and enhance the overall living conditions of the population by providing essential basic needs.
questions.solution_hi: डी.पी. धर ने पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974-78) के प्रारंभिक वर्ष में न्यूनतम आवश्यकता कार्यक्रम (MNP) की शुरुआत में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। इस कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य आवश्यक बुनियादी सुविधाएँ प्रदान कर जनसंख्या की मूलभूत आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करना व समग्र जीवन स्तर सुधारना था।
